demonstrates:
with 4000 review requests spread across 200 cases plus 4000 on one case, mixed priorities, assigned and unassigned, active and terminal, and ANALYZE run: the active queue used review_requests_queue_idx, the reviewer queue used review_requests_reviewer_idx, and a selective case history used review_requests_case_history_idx. The counter-case is recorded too — a single case holding roughly half the table is read by sequential scan, which is the planner being correct rather than the index being unused. No latency or throughput claim is made. Plans:
{
  "active_queue": "Limit  (cost=0.57..64.36 rows=100 width=26)
  ->  Nested Loop  (cost=0.57..1139.84 rows=1786 width=26)
        ->  Index Scan using review_requests_queue_idx on review_requests r  (cost=0.28..897.34 rows=7222 width=42)
              Index Cond: (organisation_id = '09c3b97d-5b94-4e11-8ca9-31cc29bdd7ea'::uuid)
        ->  Memoize  (cost=0.29..0.32 rows=1 width=16)
              Cache Key: r.case_id
              Cache Mode: logical
              ->  Index Scan using cases_pkey on cases c  (cost=0.28..0.31 rows=1 width=16)
                    Index Cond: (id = r.case_id)
                    Filter: (workspace_id = ANY ('{51ca032e-6b39-4127-bae0-7d4949e2834b}'::uuid[]))",
  "reviewer_queue": "Limit  (cost=0.57..180.95 rows=100 width=26)
  ->  Nested Loop  (cost=0.57..484.01 rows=268 width=26)
        ->  Index Scan using review_requests_reviewer_idx on review_requests r  (cost=0.28..381.30 rows=1082 width=42)
              Index Cond: (assigned_to = '2f478bf4-7625-42e1-987b-18c4ce490165'::uuid)
              Filter: (organisation_id = '09c3b97d-5b94-4e11-8ca9-31cc29bdd7ea'::uuid)
        ->  Memoize  (cost=0.29..0.39 rows=1 width=16)
              Cache Key: r.case_id
              Cache Mode: logical
              ->  Index Scan using cases_pkey on cases c  (cost=0.28..0.38 rows=1 width=16)
                    Index Cond: (id = r.case_id)
                    Filter: (workspace_id = ANY ('{51ca032e-6b39-4127-bae0-7d4949e2834b}'::uuid[]))",
  "case_history_selective": "Sort  (cost=61.83..61.88 rows=20 width=24)
  Sort Key: requested_at, id
  ->  Bitmap Heap Scan on review_requests r  (cost=4.44..61.40 rows=20 width=24)
        Recheck Cond: (case_id = '6283fd07-8903-49de-9dfb-5a3766539b96'::uuid)
        Filter: (organisation_id = '09c3b97d-5b94-4e11-8ca9-31cc29bdd7ea'::uuid)
        ->  Bitmap Index Scan on review_requests_case_history_idx  (cost=0.00..4.43 rows=20 width=0)
              Index Cond: (case_id = '6283fd07-8903-49de-9dfb-5a3766539b96'::uuid)",
  "case_history_dominant": "Sort  (cost=526.89..536.97 rows=4031 width=24)
  Sort Key: requested_at, id
  ->  Seq Scan on review_requests r  (cost=0.00..285.50 rows=4031 width=24)
        Filter: ((case_id = 'b0b87605-a9cb-4669-9265-e2a81365d148'::uuid) AND (organisation_id = '09c3b97d-5b94-4e11-8ca9-31cc29bdd7ea'::uuid))"
